rotary_engine_interchangeability.overview: Rotary engines share many components across generations, but side-port (Renesis) vs peripheral-port (13B-REW) are not directly compatible.

12a_to_13b.reason: Different rotor width (70mm vs 80mm) and displacement
12a_to_13b.notes: Some internal components like springs may be shared

13b_na_to_13b_rew.notes: Same rotor dimensions. REW has larger ports. Seals differ slightly.

13b_rew_to_renesis.reason: Renesis uses side exhaust ports - completely different housing design
13b_rew_to_renesis.notes: E-shaft and some internal bearings may interchange

13b_fc_to_fd.notes: FC turbo and FD REW housings share dimensions

13b_na_to_turbo.notes: NA housings can be used with turbo, but port work usually needed

renesis_to_rew.reason: Different rear seal and counterweight design

fc_single_to_fd.notes: Common swap to add turbo to NA FC engines

fd_sequential_to_single.notes: Most popular FD modification - eliminates sequential complexity

miata_b_series_interchangeability.overview: B6 and BP engines share many components. Both can be swapped into NA/NB Miatas with varying difficulty.

b6_head_on_bp.notes: Early experimentation done, but not recommended

bp_vvt_to_non_vvt.notes: VVT heads can be used on non-VVT blocks with cam gear swap

b6_to_bp.notes: Same transmission bolt pattern across B-series

mzr_to_skyactiv_compatibility.overview: MZR and Skyactiv are different engine families with limited compatibility.

mazdaspeed_ecu_swap.notes: Gen1 and Gen2 Mazdaspeed 3 use different ECUs

mazda3_mzr_trans_swap.notes: BK and BL Mazda3 share transmissions

13b_rew_into_na_nb.notes: Popular but challenging swap - requires significant fabrication
required: Transmission adapter or Mazda trans swap

bp_into_locost_seven.notes: Very common swap for kit cars

ford_mazda_compatibility.overview: During Ford partnership (1979-2015), many components were shared

mzr_duratec.notes: MZR and Duratec share architecture - many parts interchange

bp_escort_probe.notes: Ford Escort GT and Probe used Mazda BP engines

mzr_timing_chain.notes: Timing chain guides and tensioners share designs

b_series_timing_belt.notes: Same timing belt design - Gates T227

miata_coils.notes: Coil pack design similar across generations

mzr_coils.notes: COP coils interchangeable within MZR family

13b_rew.ecu_swap_notes: JDM ECU can be used with modifications

bp_miata.notes: JDM spec slightly higher compression available

skyactiv.compression_ratio: Some markets get 12:1 vs 13:1 based on fuel quality
